item.title: Minecraft guide: Your compendium for crafting
item.content:encoded: Keep up with the latest guides to playing the new game drops and getting started in Minecraft.

item.title: Normal memory chips couldn't withstand the hellscape of Venus so scientists have crafted something that can
item.content:encoded: Memory of the stars.

item.title: Brace yourselves, Jetpack Cat is coming to Overwatch Stadium this season and players are already prepping for it: 'My sniper build is gonna demolish her'
item.content:encoded: Jetpack Cat will also be able to pick up two teammates.

item.title: NZXT class action lawsuit settlement includes $3 million in damages, and some buyers will get to keep their rented PCs
item.content:encoded: Though they will have to fit certain criteria to keep the PCs.

item.title: Marathon isn't going to be the big hit Sony wants because it's just too much of a sicko game
item.content:encoded: Marathon is an excellent extraction shooter, but it's also its own worst enemy.

item.title: Mouse: PI for Hire review
item.content:encoded: No Mickey Mouse shooter—it's a bona fide classic

item.title: Morbid Metal is a deeply satisfying hack 'n' slash with some subpar roguelike elements, but hey, that's what early access is for
item.content:encoded: Not even its final form.

item.title: Players have already found exploits for the Sulfur Cube in Minecraft, including using it as a mode of transportation
item.content:encoded: Make the most of this blocky buddy.

item.title: 15 more Disney games delisted from Steam, including the original Star Wars: Dark Forces and 1997's Outlaws
item.content:encoded: That's 29 games delisted following another bout in January.

item.title: China's YMTC is reportedly aiming to more than double its wafer production, which could eventually help put cheap gaming SSDs back on the menu
item.content:encoded: Paying over $160 for a basic 1 TB drive at the moment just feels like a fever dream.

item.title: Stalker 2 just got a free pre-DLC to gird you for its first actual DLC
item.content:encoded: Sealed Truth is now unsealed.

item.title: You can now add 'playing pool' to the list of Lovecraftian horrors that will drive you insane, thanks to this bizarre roguelike that's got me shooting dead fish and vomiting upgrades
item.content:encoded: Pool of Madness is a terrifying look into a irrational dimension where I'm slightly better at pool.

item.title: Alienware's new $350 OLED gaming monitor could become the cheapest way to score the enviable panel tech
item.content:encoded: The AW2726DM is no slouch with a 240 Hz refresh rate and 0.03 ms response time.

item.title: WoW's Burning Crusade Classic servers are removing the time-honoured tradition of dungeon boosting
item.content:encoded: No boosts for you.

item.title: Gigabyte's latest Intel motherboard is a little bit sideways, and it's all about reaching 10,400 MT/s with a megabucks DRAM kit
item.content:encoded: That rear IO panel is giving me the ick, though.

item.title: Windows 11 now lets you skip the time-consuming updates on a fresh install. Neat!
item.content:encoded: One small step towards rebuilding user goodwill.

item.title: Antarctic Peninsula's long-awaited rework adds a new environmental hazard to Overwatch that'll be a pain for flyers
item.content:encoded: The rework also changes the maps to "smooth out team pushes".

item.title: How to prepare for Hello Kitty Island Adventure's City Town DLC
item.content:encoded: Make sure your pals on Friendship Island are ready for the new adventure.

item.title: Researchers have developed a way to peek inside electronic parts as they're running and plan to see if they can snoop encrypted data
item.content:encoded: If that's got you worried about security, then don't panic: a little bit of metal solves that problem entirely.

item.title: Find Your Words uses a way of communicating I've never experienced in a game before
item.content:encoded: A day at summer camp turned into a game I'll remember for a while.

item.title: Nvidia denies report that it is in talks to acquire a major PC company but Dell, HP, Lenovo and Asus share prices jumped at the thought
item.content:encoded: Nvidia has its eyes on closer integration with PC partners.

item.title: Co-op pirate survival game Windrose: should you grab it in early access?
item.content:encoded: Here's what I've found after around 24 hours on the high seas.

item.title: Bloodborne is getting an R-rated film adaptation co-produced by JackSepticEye
item.content:encoded: Anything but a PC port, obviously.

item.title: Send us your best gaming clips from Crimson Desert and you could win $500 in Steam gift cards
item.content:encoded: We know you're having fun in there. Show us, and you could win big.

item.title: Xbox Game Pass is too expensive, new Xbox boss reportedly says: 'we need a better value equation'
item.content:encoded: It needs to be a more flexible system, apparently.

item.title: After his city builder flopped in early access, Firewatch's Nels Anderson didn't give up: 'Smarter people than me … probably would've pulled the plug'
item.content:encoded: Generation Exile hits 1.0 this week after over seven years of development.

item.title: Rockstar hackers release their stolen data, reveal that Rockstar was right to not pay them anything for it
item.content:encoded: It's interesting, but... is that it?

item.title: A 'free kit frenzy' mode for cheapskates arrives in Marathon this week
item.content:encoded: Bungie hopes to learn the merits of a dedicated "zero to hero" mode.

item.title: 91-year-old gamer gets a visit from police after she misses her daily check-in call because she was 'trying to beat her record level'
item.content:encoded: You won't believe what happened next, maybe.

item.title: Temu-tier Palworld imitator Pickmon changes a single title letter 'to better align with our brand identity' and definitely not for any other reason, guys, honest
item.content:encoded: Publisher NetworkGo says its title tweak is "a better vessel for the fantasy adventure we are building for you."

item.title: Despite rumors of a GTA 6-inspired delay, Fable studio says it's 'excited to welcome you back to Albion in autumn 2026'
item.content:encoded: Consider that rumor denied.

item.title: If you're finding Resident Evil: Requiem a bit scary, why not mod it to make the enemies tiny
item.content:encoded: Makes Chunk look adorable.

item.title: The voice of GTA 5's Lester wonders if GTA 6 'can't make the same splash as previous games' because the world is just so weird now
item.content:encoded: How can you pull off satire when reality is stranger than fiction?

item.title: A Valve developer has just made it easier to run games on Linux with 8 GB cards thanks to a simple fix
item.content:encoded: You just need to be on an Arch-based distro, for now.

item.title: AtomMan G1 Pro review
item.content:encoded: Remarkably well thought out, just remember to bring a USB hub.

item.title: The new Linux 7.0 kernel is here and as always, it's all about lots of little improvements rather than one significant update
item.content:encoded: Tux is looking a little more dapper with every update.

item.title: Task Manager's creator says it used to be 50 times smaller because 'in that time and place, small was fast and fast mattered'
item.content:encoded: "It has to look calm even when the rest of the system is not."

item.title: These custom Linux lock screens styled after Minecraft, NieR Automata, and Genshin Impact are single-handedly eroding my loyalty to Windows
item.content:encoded: Have it your way.

item.title: Crimson Desert players have a new way to slay its powerful bosses—slowly unleashing a swarm of individually-caged bees at them
item.content:encoded: Float like a butterfly, sting like a… you know.

item.title: Todd Howard says Starfield's NG+ was misunderstood and defends Bethesda's new U-turn on how it works: 'You can tell us if we've done our job right'
item.content:encoded: "We want to be trying to do more things that update the game where it's going to change the next 100 hours."

item.title: Metro 2039 confirmed as the next game in the Metro series, full reveal coming later this week
item.content:encoded: The rumors were true.

item.title: Overwatch's hero ban system is being reworked, which means we may be able to ignore the role-limit rule and ban a 5th hero
item.content:encoded: Those are rookie numbers, we need to up it to at least 20.

item.title: Epic is reportedly cooking up a Disney extraction shooter, and suggestions staff are lukewarm on it are 'not reflective of the ambitions of the Disney collaboration'
item.content:encoded: I predict a playerbase so cutthroat it makes Escape From Tarkov look like a teambuilding retreat.

item.title: Nearly here! Microsoft ups the partition size limit of FAT32 from 32 GB to 2 TB in the latest beta of Windows 11
item.content:encoded: Got deja vu? Yeah, me too.

item.title: Bethesda's ex-marketing VP says Skyrim was its first game to make other studios scared of it: 'You have to be concerned about us if you think you're going to win game of the year'
item.content:encoded: The fear of Todd, they call it.

item.title: Pragmata review
item.content:encoded: Short and sweet, Pragmata is a snazzy late aughts throwback elevated by a terrific sense of feedback and momentum.

item.title: YouTuber builds PC side panel out of 15 Noctua fans and names it the 'Superdome', cuts temps by 20 °C
item.content:encoded: "It started as a meme, but I think I might actually leave this on my PC."

item.title: Lucky Redditor gets hands on unreleased Steelseries Rival Pro Mini, revealing another UWB wireless gaming mouse will soon hit the market
item.content:encoded: Don't call it a comeback.

item.title: Crimson Desert update has a few surprise improvements, like finally letting you teleport on your horse and a new ability
item.content:encoded: Do a Focused Aerial Roll!
